description: A person can create a note titled Lamp and see that title with an empty body.
steps: Open the page with an empty store
See Lamp in the list and an empty body

description: An empty title, or a title over 80 characters, is refused. Clearing the title of an existing note is refused and the previous title stays.
steps: Press n and Enter without a title
See data-error-code note.title.required and an unchanged store
Press n, type 81 characters, and press Enter
See data-error-code note.title.too_long and an unchanged store
On an existing note titled Lamp, clear the title and press Enter
See note.title.required and the stored title still Lamp

description: The body desk is still there after reload.
d on the selected note removes it, including after reload.
Hold v, speak a new note titled Lamp, and see that title with an empty body.
steps: Open the page with an empty store
The page posts a sound file to /api/talk
The returned instruction is create with title Lamp
See Lamp in the list and an empty body

description: A spoken create with an empty title is refused and the store stays empty.
steps: The returned instruction is create with a blank title
See data-error-code note.title.required and an unchanged store

description: A spoken delete removes the selected note, including after reload.
